Definition: from a compound of G2095 and G4241; good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness:--grace.
BiblicalUsage: euprépeia is the word for grace. In James 1:11, the text says "and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, euprépeia, I take at face value: grace.
